detailed_description: Aspect Ratio Box Generator creates CSS code for responsive containers that maintain a specific width-to-height ratio regardless of screen size. Choose from common presets like 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, or enter custom ratios. The tool generates both modern CSS using the aspect-ratio property and a padding-bottom fallback for older browsers. Perfect for video embeds, image placeholders, card layouts, and any element that needs to maintain proportions. Get clean, cross-browser compatible CSS code instantly.
paddingNote: Note: Padding method is for older browser support
